summary: Climb Bio, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 9,481,000 shares at $9.50 per share and 2,106,000 pre-funded warrants at $9.4999 per warrant to institutional investors, including an RA Capital affiliate. Gross proceeds are ~$110 million. Leerink Partners and Piper Sandler are lead placement agents. The transaction is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. Closing is expected April 29, 2026. No strategic event or control change is involved.
